title: Digital Account Manager
description:
UNIQLO AGENCY IS HIRING – DIGITAL ACCOUNT MANAGER

Remote | Part-time


At Uniqlo Agency , we don’t just run campaigns — we craft influence. To do that, we’re looking for a Digital Account Manager who is strategic, data-driven, client-focused, and sharp enough to turn insights into impact.


ABOUT THE ROLE


This is not just an account management role — it’s a value creation role.


As a Digital Account Manager, you will act as the strategic liaison between clients and our internal teams. From brief to execution to performance tracking, your job is to ensure everything runs smoothly, aligned with client objectives, and above all — effectively.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients, ensuring long-term satisfaction and growth
  • Coordinate with internal teams to execute digital campaigns: media, creative, performance, branding, etc.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on client goals and market context
  • Monitor campaign performance, prepare reports, and proactively optimize as needed
  • Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities to maximize client value
  • Manage contracts, budgets, timelines, and deliverables with transparency and accountability


REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum 3 years of experience as an Account Manager in an agency or digital/SaaS environment
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Vietnamese
  • Strong understanding of the digital ecosystem: paid media, CRM, automation, SEO, analytics, etc.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to extract insights and translate them into strategic actions
  • Strong time management and multitasking capabilities
  • Proactive attitude, solution-oriented mindset, and a genuine passion for digital marketing


WHY UNIQLO AGENCY

  • Flexible remote, part-time working model — ideal for experienced freelancers looking for long-term partnerships
  • Opportunities to work with ambitious brands across multiple industries
  • A collaborative, high-performance team culture with space for growth and creativity
  • Clear growth path — if you’re good, we’ll make sure you grow even further

At Uniqlo Agency , we don’t just run campaigns — we craft influence. To do that, we’re looking for a Digital Account Manager who is strategic, data-driven, client-focused, and sharp enough to turn insights into impact.


ABOUT THE ROLE


This is not just an account management role — it’s a value creation role.


As a Digital Account Manager, you will act as the strategic liaison between clients and our internal teams. From brief to execution to performance tracking, your job is to ensure everything runs smoothly, aligned with client objectives, and above all — effectively.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients, ensuring long-term satisfaction and growth
  • Coordinate with internal teams to execute digital campaigns: media, creative, performance, branding, etc.
  • Provide strategic recommendations based on client goals and market context
  • Monitor campaign performance, prepare reports, and proactively optimize as needed
  • Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities to maximize client value
  • Manage contracts, budgets, timelines, and deliverables with transparency and accountability


REQUIREMENTS

  • Minimum 3 years of experience as an Account Manager in an agency or digital/SaaS environment
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Vietnamese
  • Strong understanding of the digital ecosystem: paid media, CRM, automation, SEO, analytics, etc.
  • Data-driven mindset with the ability to extract insights and translate them into strategic actions
  • Strong time management and multitasking capabilities
  • Proactive attitude, solution-oriented mindset, and a genuine passion for digital marketing


WHY UNIQLO AGENCY

  • Flexible remote, part-time working model — ideal for experienced freelancers looking for long-term partnerships
  • Opportunities to work with ambitious brands across multiple industries
  • A collaborative, high-performance team culture with space for growth and creativity
  • Clear growth path — if you’re good, we’ll make sure you grow even further

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.



We are currently hiring a Senior Frontend Engineer an initial 12-month Fixed Term Contract.



Responsibilities:

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture: Designs solutions for complex problems and large features. Makes architectural decisions, considering scalability, maintainability, performance, and security. Defines technical standards and best practices for the team.
  • Mentorship & Guidance: Actively mentors junior and mid-level developers, fostering their growth. Leads code reviews, ensuring high quality and consistency across the codebase.
  • Strategic Thinking: Understands the broader product goals and business context. Anticipates future technical challenges and opportunities. Evaluates new technologies and advocates for their adoption where appropriate.
  • Complex Problem Solving: Tackles the most challenging technical issues, often involving deep debugging, performance analysis, or system-level interactions.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Often acts as a technical point person, collaborating effectively with other teams (Backend, DevOps, Product, Design) and potentially influencing technical direction beyond the immediate front-end team.
  • Sparring Partner for Designers: Gives feedback from a technical perspective on the feasibility of a design and proposes alternatives which complement and improve it.
  • Process Improvement: Identifies and drives improvements in team processes, tooling, and development workflows.


Requirements:

  • Expertise: Deep and broad expertise in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including nuances, performance implications, and upcoming features.
  • Frameworks/Libraries: Mastery of one or more frameworks/libraries, including their internals, advanced patterns, and ecosystem. Can evaluate and choose appropriate technologies for new projects.
  • Tools: Expert-level understanding of the entire front-end toolchain (build systems, CI/CD, testing strategies, monitoring).
  • Concepts: Deep understanding of architectural patterns, advanced state management, web performance optimisation, security vulnerabilities and mitigation, different testing paradigms (E2E), infrastructure considerations (CDNs, caching).
  • System Design: Ability to design robust, scalable, and maintainable front-end systems and component libraries. Understands trade-offs between different technical approaches
  • Must Have Technologies:

Excellent knowledge of Angular and be up to date until version 19

GraphQL

TypeScript

NodeJs

Prisma / PostgreSQL

Using AWS as a back end for front end (Lambda functions, DynamoDB, event driven architecture)

Open Search, building queries programmatically

Writing e2e tests using Cypress

Writing unit tests using Jest

Fluent in HTML5, CSS3 and SASS, Tailwind

Highly skilled building pixel perfect, snappy interfaces

Mobile web interfaces optimised for different platforms

Building highly reactive user interfaces

  • Nice-To-Have Technologies:

Having experience with crafting meaningful animations that support the UX

Experience with image manipulation and face detection libraries in NodeJs



The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach
  • Be experienced with or passionate about guiding other developers
  • Take on a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together? A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.
company: 绿新(福建)食品有限公司

title: Senior Data Analytics
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Senior Data Analytics para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

O profissional será responsável por transformar dados complexos em informações estratégicas, gerando insights que apoiarão a tomada de decisões em várias áreas da empresa, incluindo finanças, clientes e software.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar, estrategicamente, dados: Conduzir análises quantitativas e qualitativas aprofundadas sobre dados financeiros, comportamentais e operacionais, identificando tendências, gargalos e oportunidades de otimização.
  • Gerar valor e insights acionáveis: Transformar dados brutos em recomendações claras e impactantes que otimizem processos, melhorem a tomada de decisões e contribuam diretamente para os resultados de negócio da Jusfy.
  • Automatizar e otimizar: Desenvolver e implementar scripts e pipelines para automatizar a coleta, processamento e análise de dados, garantindo eficiência e escalabilidade das nossas operações.
  • Desenvolver soluções de BI: Criar e manter dashboards, relatórios e visualizações de dados intuitivos para diferentes stakeholders, utilizando ferramentas como Power BI, Metabase ou Tableau, garantindo que os dados sejam acessíveis e compreendidos.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com as equipes de Finanças, Marketing, Produto e Desenvolvimento, entendendo suas necessidades de dados e construindo soluções personalizadas que apoiem seus objetivos.
  • Dominar os KPIs do SaaS: Aplicar profundo conhecimento em indicadores chave de performance (KPIs) específicos para o modelo de Software as a Service (SaaS).


Requisitos:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos como Analista de Dados ou em atividade similar, com vivência em transformação de dados em automação e resultados de negócio, preferencialmente com foco em dados financeiros, de clientes e de software.
  • Domínio de SQL para manipulação e consulta de dados, e experiência com Python ou R para análise, automação e desenvolvimento de modelos.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Power BI, Metabase, Tableau ou similares.
  • Conhecimento prático em bancos de dados relacionais (ex.: Postgres) e não relacionais (ex.: MongoDB).
  • Capacidade de identificar problemas, propor soluções baseadas em dados e implementá-las de forma autônoma.
  • Habilidade para traduzir análises complexas em insights claros e concisos para diferentes públicos.


Desejável:

  • Experiência prévia em ambiente SaaS;
  • Conhecimento de governança de dados


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.


Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Analista de Dados Sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga!

title: Data Engineer
description:
A Infosys Brasil está buscando profissionais com o perfil de Data Engineer (JR.)


Principais atividades e responsabilidades

  • Experiência em projetar, criar e manter módulos e serviços Cloud para dados e análises.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados e processos de ETL usando os serviços de dados e análise do GCP ( preferencialmente), e linguagens de programação como Python e SQL.
  • Desenvolver scripts de automação e orquestração para implantar e gerenciar recursos de dados e análise em cloud, usando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible e Jenkins.
  • Conhecimento profundo dos serviços e da arquitetura de dados, incluindo experiência com DataFlow, DataProc, BigQuery e Pub/Sub.
  • Habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.


Qualificações necessárias

  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software ou em uma área relacionada.
  • Conhecimento profundo em banco de dados SQL.
  • Inglês avançado.


Benefícios


  • Tipo de trabalho : CLT , Horários flexíveis e formato híbrido (presencial e remoto).
  • Pacote de benefícios: Vale Transporte, Ticket Refeição, Assistência médica-hospitalar e Odontológico, Auxílio Creche, Auxílio Dependente (filho PCD) , Seguro de Vida, Auxílio Funerário e PLR.
  • Carreira: Atuação Global em clientes e/ou projetos nacionais e internacionais, e possibilidade de movimentação de carreira internacional.
  • Desenvolvimento: Infosys Global Education Center é a maior universidade corporativa do mundo, disponibilizamos mais de 80 mil títulos de treinamentos internos, além dos cursos e certificações com parceiros homologados (Microsoft, Google, Amazon e SAP), sem custos para todos os nossos profissionais.


About Us


Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.


Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

title: Arquiteto de Software .NET
description:
Entregamos soluções personalizadas que auxiliam nossos clientes, de maneira ágil e eficaz, na promoção da transformação digital de seus negócios. Acreditamos que a tecnologia é um agente de inovação, com o intuito de melhorar a vida das pessoas de forma descomplicada.


Buscamos um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Software .NET para atuar de forma REMOTA em um projeto estratégico, com foco em escalabilidade, alto desempenho e inovação tecnológica.


Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, otimizar e manter plataformas críticas;
  • Propor melhorias e reconstruções de infraestrutura;
  • Colaborar com Engenharia na resolução de problemas;
  • Desenvolver sistemas escaláveis, monitoráveis e autônomos;
  • Garantir a integração e funcionamento das plataformas.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Programação orientada a objetos com domínio em .NET;
  • Experiência na criação de APIs REST e gRPC.


Boas práticas:

  • Aplicação de SOLID, KISS, Arquitetura Hexagonal e Limpa;
  • Conhecimento em Design Patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, CQRS, Event Sourcing).


Observabilidade e Monitoramento:

  • Ferramentas como Datadog, New Relic, Kibana, Grafana;
  • Coleta de métricas, logs estruturados, dashboards e alertas.


Infraestrutura:

  • Mensageria: RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus;
  • Bancos de dados: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis;
  • Cache: Redis, Memcached;
  • Segurança: Vault, Secrets Manager, Kubernetes (ConfigMaps e Secrets);
  • Jobs assíncronos: Workers, Locks Distribuídos (Redlock, Zookeeper).


Resiliência e Performance:

  • Retry com backoff, Circuit Breaker (Resilience4j, Hystrix), DLQ, Rate-limiting, Defensive Cache.


Arquitetura orientada a eventos:

  • EDA, Event Sourcing, CQRS;
  • Publicação/consumo assíncrono com Kafka, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus.

title: Head de Tecnologia Latam
description:
Será responsável por liderar a área local de tecnologia da informação, alinhando as ações com as diretrizes estratégicas da empresa e buscando constantemente oportunidades de inovação.

Terá um papel fundamental no desenvolvimento e entrega de soluções tecnológicas voltadas à frente comercial, apoiando o crescimento das vendas e a excelência na jornada do cliente.

Também atuará como impulsionador de iniciativas em sistemas de informação que contribuam para a eficiência operacional e a expansão do negócio.

Além disso, garantirá a qualidade e o custo ideal dos serviços de TI, em colaboração com equipes regionais de tecnologia, infraestrutura, digital e estratégia.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência consolidada em tecnologia da informação e sistemas, com histórico de liderança de equipes, gestão de projetos e entrega consistente de resultados.
  • Vivência na implementação e sustentação de soluções tecnológicas voltadas à área comercial e operacional, como CRM, plataformas de e-commerce, DMS, gestão de leads, entre outras ferramentas que apoiam o desempenho de vendas.
  • Forte capacidade de compreender necessidades funcionais de diferentes áreas de negócio, inclusive em contextos multiculturais ou internacionais.
  • Visão proativa sobre tendências tecnológicas e disposição contínua para aprendizado e atualização.
  • Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e adaptáveis, com habilidade para reagir rapidamente a mudanças estratégicas, legais ou de mercado.
  • Inglês avançado.

title: Sr Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Como será seu dia a dia

Na Avenue, promovemos a qualidade desde o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento, com foco em prevenção de problemas e aplicação do mindset shift-left testing . Você fará parte de um time multifuncional, atuando com testes manuais e automatizados em diferentes camadas do produto, sendo referência na cultura de qualidade.


Responsabilidades

  • Promover a cultura de qualidade e o mindset shift-left dentro e fora do time.
  • Planejar, projetar e executar testes manuais e automatizados (UI, API, Mobile).
  • Apoiar o time em refinamentos, planejamento e definição de critérios de aceitação.
  • Participar ativamente do ciclo de desenvolvimento, garantindo a qualidade em todas as fases.
  • Realizar code reviews, testes exploratórios e avaliações de risco.
  • Monitorar entregas, analisar métricas e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Mentorar QAs juniores e colaborar com o capítulo de QA.
  • Documentar bugs e apoiar na análise pós-mortem de falhas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em QA.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes de software e automação (Cypress, Selenium, Postman).
  • Experiência com linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou Go.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD, Git, bancos de dados (SQL) e cloud (GCP ou AWS).

title: SAP SuccessFactors Integration Consultant
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Integration Development: Design, develop, deploy, and maintain integration processes between applications across cloud and/or on-premise systems using the Dell Boomi platform.
  • SAP SuccessFactors Expertise: Work on integrating SAP SuccessFactors with SAP S/4HANA, third-party systems, and other SaaS applications.
  • Custom iFlows: Develop custom integration flows (iFlows) to connect SAP SuccessFactors with various systems.
  • API Management: Utilize APIs, MDM (Master Data Management), and enterprise web services for seamless integration.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting: Conduct rigorous testing of integration processes and resolve any issues to ensure smooth functionality.
  • Documentation: Prepare detailed technical documentation for integration processes and workflows.

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency in SAP SuccessFactors and Dell Boomi platform.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud integration, application integration, and enterprise web services.
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Platform Integration (SAP CPI) and SAP PO/PI is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ABAP and APIs development.
  • Strong experience in integration consulting.
  • Languages: Advanced English and Portuguese.

title: Keeta - Business Analyst (Traffic Analysis)
description:
Job Introduction:

Optimize traffic allocation through data analysis to drive transaction growth. Requires 4+ years in traffic analysis, SQL expertise, and project management. Highlights: Impact core business metrics while collaborating with global teams on Meituan's international expansion.


Job Responsibilities:

1. Develop traffic analysis frameworks based on business objectives to guide traffic allocation optimization.

2. Establish user-side traffic evaluation mechanisms, optimize traffic resources, and drive iterative traffic strategies.

3. Analyze in-app user behavior to understand how traffic allocation drives transaction growth and provide actionable recommendations.

4. Evaluate various traffic allocation methods to identify high-efficiency investment opportunities.

5. Participate in goal-setting, experiment design, monitoring, and evaluation of key traffic distribution projects.


Job Requirements:

1. 4+ years in internet traffic analysis with deep business logic understanding (traffic operations experience preferred).

2. Strong logical thinking with both strategic vision and attention to detail.

3. SQL proficiency for data extraction, analysis, and insight-driven reporting.

4. Project management skills and effective stakeholder communication.

5. Goal-oriented, self-motivated, and skilled in summarization.


Job Highlights:

1. Join Meituan's global expansion team working with international talents.

2. Own core traffic evaluation with direct business impact.
